meta.title: Materials
meta.description: An add-only multi-format materials library for DeepSeek Harness: pick Markdown, text/code, HTML, images, PDF, audio and video from your workspaces, place icons on a fixed non-overlapping desktop grid, right-drag a marquee to select and move groups, put multi-selections into folders, and open anything full-screen with browser-style tabs and an immersive full-bleed reading mode. Each type has its own viewer: Markdown renders GFM tables plus Mermaid and chart blocks, HTML previews in a sandbox with same-folder assets, images zoom smoothly with Shift+wheel and switch to actual size on click, and PDF, audio and video play in place. Document path-bar actions carry short labels and can reveal the current file in the system file manager.
